description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named SecurityController that manages user profile viewing and editing functionalities, including profile retrieval, user info updates, and partial updates with authentication checks.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling user profile display and update operations, secured to users with ROLE_USER.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/profile', retrieves the current user's profile and enrolled courses, and returns the 'user/profile' view.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/user/edit/{userID}', verifies user authorization, and returns the user editing view.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/edit/{userID}', updates user information if authorized, then redirects to profile.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/patch/{id_user}', updates user details partially if authorized, then redirects to profile.
